name: pmkisan_generate_otp
description: Sends a one-time password (OTP) to the mobile number linked with the farmer's Aadhaar for PM-KISAN authentication. This is the first step in the authentication flow. It does NOT verify the OTP or create a session — use pmkisan_verify_otp for that. Fails if the Aadhaar number is invalid (not 12 digits) or the mobile number is not registered with Aadhaar. This tool cannot be used to reset passwords or recover accounts.

name: pmkisan_verify_otp
description: Verifies the OTP sent to the farmer's mobile number and returns a session_token upon successful authentication. The OTP must have been generated using pmkisan_generate_otp. This tool does NOT check beneficiary status or payment details — it only authenticates. Fails if the OTP is expired, incorrect, or if pmkisan_generate_otp was not called first. The session_token is required for all subsequent PM-KISAN API calls.

otp.description: 6-digit OTP received on the registered mobile number.

name: pmkisan_register_farmer
description: Registers a new farmer for PM-KISAN benefits by submitting personal, land ownership, and bank account details. Transitions registration_status from 'not_registered' to 'registered'. Requires a valid session_token from pmkisan_verify_otp. This tool does NOT verify eligibility or complete eKYC — those are separate steps. Fails if the Aadhaar is already registered (duplicate prevention enforced), land details are invalid, or bank account details are incomplete. Only one beneficiary record is allowed per Aadhaar.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

farmer_name.description: Full name of the farmer as per Aadhaar records.

state.description: State where the farmer's land is located.

district.description: District where the farmer's land is located.

village.description: Village where the farmer's agricultural land is situated.

land_area_hectares.description: Total cultivable land area in hectares owned by the farmer.

bank_account_number.description: Bank account number for receiving DBT payments.

ifsc_code.description: IFSC code of the bank branch.

name: pmkisan_check_eligibility
description: Checks whether the farmer is eligible for PM-KISAN benefits based on Aadhaar, land records, and exclusion criteria. Returns eligibility_status as 'eligible', 'ineligible', or 'rejected' with reasons. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT register the farmer or process payments — it only checks eligibility. Fails if the farmer is not registered (registration_status must be 'registered' or 'verified'). Ineligible farmers include those excluded under scheme rules (e.g., income tax payers, institutional landholders).

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkisan_complete_ekyc
description: Completes OTP-based eKYC for the farmer under PM-KISAN. Transitions ekyc_status from 'not_started' or 'failed' to 'completed'. eKYC is mandatory — without it, all installment payments are blocked. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT check eKYC status — use pmkisan_get_beneficiary_status for that. Fails if the Aadhaar-mobile linkage is invalid, the eKYC OTP is incorrect, or eKYC is already completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkisan_get_beneficiary_status
description: Retrieves the current beneficiary status of the farmer including registration_status, ekyc_status, eligibility_status, and linked bank details. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT modify any status or process payments — it is read-only. Fails if the farmer is not registered in PM-KISAN. Returns 'not_registered' if no record exists for the given Aadhaar.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkisan_get_payment_history
description: Retrieves the complete payment history of the farmer under PM-KISAN, including all past installments (₹2000 each, 3 per year totaling ₹6000/year), their dates, amounts, and transaction statuses. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT show upcoming or pending installments — use pmkisan_track_installment_status for that. Fails if the farmer is not registered. Returns empty history if no payments have been processed yet.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkisan_track_installment_status
description: Tracks the status of a specific PM-KISAN installment for the farmer. Returns installment_status ('due', 'processed', 'credited', 'failed') and reasons for any failure. Installments may fail if eKYC is not completed, bank details are invalid, or eligibility is not confirmed. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT process or trigger payments — it only reports status. Fails if the farmer is not registered or has no active installments.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

installment_number.description: Installment number to query (1, 2, or 3 for the respective installment of the financial year).

financial_year.description: Financial year for the installment query, e.g., '2024-25'.

name: pmkisan_update_bank_details
description: Updates the bank account details linked to the farmer's PM-KISAN account. Aadhaar-bank linkage is required — payments fail if Aadhaar is not linked to a valid bank account. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT verify whether payments have resumed after the update — use pmkisan_track_payment for that. Fails if the bank account number or IFSC code is invalid, or if the account does not belong to the Aadhaar holder.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

bank_account_number.description: New bank account number for receiving DBT payments.

ifsc_code.description: IFSC code of the new bank branch.

name: pmkisan_track_payment
description: Tracks the payment processing status of a specific PM-KISAN transaction. Returns payment_status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'credited', 'failed') along with transaction reference and failure reasons. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT initiate payments or resolve failures — use pmkisan_resolve_payment_failure for resolution. Fails if no payment record exists for the given beneficiary or transaction reference.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

beneficiary_id.description: Unique identifier of the PM-KISAN beneficiary.

transaction_reference.description: Transaction reference number for a specific payment. Optional — if not provided, returns the latest payment status.

name: pmkisan_validate_land_records
description: Validates the farmer's land ownership records against state land databases. Land record verification is required for PM-KISAN eligibility. Returns verification status and any discrepancies found. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT update or correct land records — the farmer must contact the state revenue department for corrections. Fails if the Aadhaar does not match any land records in the state database, or if the state land records system is unavailable.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

state.description: State where the farmer's land is located.

district.description: District where the farmer's land is located.

name: pmkisan_resolve_payment_failure
description: Initiates resolution for a failed PM-KISAN payment. Identifies the cause of failure (incorrect bank details, Aadhaar mismatch, eKYC incomplete) and triggers appropriate corrective actions. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT directly credit payments — it initiates the resolution process. Fails if no failed payment exists for the beneficiary, or if the failure cause requires manual intervention (e.g., state-level data correction).

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

beneficiary_id.description: Unique identifier of the PM-KISAN beneficiary.

transaction_reference.description: Transaction reference of the failed payment.

name: pmkisan_get_installment_schedule
description: Retrieves the installment schedule for the current financial year showing expected dates and amounts for all 3 installments (₹2000 each). Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT track actual payment status — use pmkisan_track_installment_status for that. Returns the standard schedule; actual credit dates may vary. Fails if the farmer is not registered or not eligible.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

financial_year.description: Financial year for the schedule, e.g., '2024-25'.

name: pmkisan_resolve_eligibility_ambiguity
description: Resolves ambiguous eligibility results when pmkisan_check_eligibility returns conflicting or unclear status. Provides detailed breakdown of eligibility criteria and which specific conditions are met or unmet. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT change eligibility status — it only provides detailed analysis. Fails if no eligibility check has been performed yet or the farmer is not registered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkisan_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance related to PM-KISAN on behalf of the farmer. Valid grievance categories include: 'payment_not_received', 'ekyc_issue', 'bank_account_issue', 'eligibility_issue', 'registration_issue'. The farmer MUST first check their beneficiary or payment status before raising a grievance. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT resolve grievances or track their status — use pmkisan_track_grievance_status for tracking. Fails if the grievance category is invalid, description is empty, or a duplicate grievance already exists for the same issue.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

grievance_category.description: Category of the grievance. Allowed values: 'payment_not_received', 'ekyc_issue', 'bank_account_issue', 'eligibility_issue', 'registration_issue'.

description.description: Detailed description of the issue faced by the farmer.

name: pmkisan_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks the status of a previously raised PM-KISAN grievance using the grievance ID. Returns the current resolution status, assigned officer, and any remarks or updates. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT raise new grievances — use pmkisan_raise_grievance for that. Fails if the grievance ID is invalid or does not belong to the authenticated farmer.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

grievance_id.description: Unique identifier of the grievance returned when the complaint was raised.
